capability.summary: Look up an Open Food Facts product by barcode
capability.description: Fetches the Open Food Facts v2 product endpoint for one required barcode. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
capability.problem_space: Packaged-food product metadata; not nutrition advice, product recommendation, or barcode generation.

constraint.io_signature: Input: barcode at CLI position 1. Output: shared JSON envelope with url, http_status, and Open Food Facts result. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
constraint.output_shape: HTTP 2xx/3xx: {status: "success", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}. HTTP 4xx/5xx: {status: "error", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}, exit 1. Request exception: {status: "error", tool: string, message: string}, exit 1.
limitations: no field selection, locale, revision, pagination, or product search input
wrapper does not locally truncate or parse the product object
coverage and freshness depend on community-maintained product data; no authentication, cache, or retry

output_contract.description: Shared JSON envelope containing one Open Food Facts product response, URL, and HTTP status.

intent_tags: look up food product by barcode
retrieve Open Food Facts nutrition metadata
negative_intents: recommend a diet or assess medical nutrition

output_contract.description: Shared JSON envelope containing one Open Food Facts product response, URL, and HTTP status.
